'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[2021 Taliban offensive]]
****Dawa Khan Menapal, head of the [[Ministry of Information and Culture (Afghanistan)|Government Media and Information Centre]], is assassinated in [[Kabul]]. The [[Taliban]] claims responsibility for the killing, saying that Menapal "was punished for his actions". [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-says-it-has-killed-afghan-governments-top-media-officer-2021-08-06/ (Reuters)]
****The Taliban captures [[Zaranj]], the provincial capital of [[Nimruz Province]], making it the first major capture of a provincial city by the group since the [[United States invasion of Afghanistan|2001 invasion]]. A spokesperson for the local [[Afghan National Police|police]] confirms that the city has fallen into Taliban control and blames the lack of reinforcements of [[Afghan Armed Forces|military]] from the central [[government of Afghanistan|government]]. [https://thewest.com.au/news/conflict/taliban-target-two-provincial-capitals-c-3614411 (''The West Australia'')]
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**[[Hezbollah]] fires twenty rockets at [[Northern Israel|northern Israel]] from Lebanon, its heaviest barrage since [[2006 war in Lebanon|the 2006 war]] and the second firing of rockets in the past week. The [[Israel Defense Forces]] respond with artillery attacks. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/rocket-alert-sirens-sound-in-golan-heights/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.voanews.com/middle-east/hezbollah-launches-20-rockets-northern-israel-which-responds-artillery (VOA)]
**[[Lebanese Druze]] villagers confront the Hezbollah rocket-launch convoy after it fires at Israel, accusing the militant group of endangering them by firing projectiles near civilian houses. The [[Lebanese Army]] later confiscates the launcher and arrests four suspects. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/lebanese-druze-halt-hezbollah-rocket-launcher-convoy-after-attack-on-israel/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/in-rare-challenge-hezbollah-fighters-held-after-rocket-launch/ar-AAN15gU (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2021]]
**[[2021 Greece wildfires]]
***Mass evacuations are carried out in the northern [[suburb]]s of [[Athens]] as [[wildfire]]s continue to burn on the outskirts of the capital. A volunteer firefighter is killed by a fallen electricity pylon, while another man dies in a factory. Twenty more people are wounded. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-58124129 (BBC News)]
**[[2021 British Columbia wildfires]]
***The village of [[Monte Lake, British Columbia|Monte Lake]] is destroyed by the fast-moving White Rock Lake wildfire, while the city of [[Kamloops]] places several of its southern neighbourhoods on evacuation alert. Around 300 fires are currently burning in [[British Columbia]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/aug/06/canada-wildfire-monte-lake-climate-crisis (''The Guardian'')]
**[[2021 California wildfires]]
***The [[Dixie Fire]] becomes the third largest wildfire in [[California]]'s history. [https://www.npr.org/2021/08/06/1025495042/dixie-fire-california-wildfire-greenville (NPR)]
**Severe fires erupt across the region of [[Calabria]], [[Italy]], killing two people in [[Reggio Calabria]]. The country is battling several fires, mainly in the centre-south regions and on the two islands. [https://www.ilfattoquotidiano.it/2021/08/06/incendi-critica-la-situazione-a-reggio-calabria-due-morti-il-sindaco-abbiamo-chiesto-lo-stato-di-emergenza/6285264/amp/ (''Il Fatto Quotidiano'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] surpasses one million cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/japan-covid-cases-delta-variant-1.6131843 (CBC News)]
****Japan reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Lambda variant]] in a woman in her 30s who arrived at [[Haneda Airport]] on July 20 after travelling to [[Peru]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/08/07/national/science-health/japan-lambda/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 20,889 new cases of COVID-19, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,224,595. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/malaysia-covid-19-cases-aug-6-brought-dead-2096521 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 community quarantines in the Philippines]]
*****[[Metro Manila]], [[Laguna (province)|Laguna]], [[Iloilo City]], and [[Cagayan de Oro]] enter enhanced community quarantine until August 20 for Metro Manila and August 15 for the other regions. [https://mb.com.ph/2021/08/05/laguna-iloilo-city-cdo-move-to-ecq-from-aug-6-15/ (Manila Bulletin)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Singapore]]
*****Indoor dining and other leisure activities will resume in [[Singapore]] for fully vaccinated individuals in groups of up to five people beginning on August 10. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/dining-vaccinated-people-covid-19-aug-10-hawkers-2096546 (CNA)]
*****The [[Ministry of Health (Singapore)|Ministry of Health]] announces that it will recognise all [[COVID-19 vaccine]]s including those listed under the emergency use listing of the [[World Health Organization]] beginning on August 10 and that these vaccines will also be included in the statistics of the national vaccination programme. [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/those-vaccinated-with-sinovac-sinopharm-astrazeneca-covishield-and-jj-shots-will-be (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]]
****[[Sri Lanka]] suspends state festivals and public gatherings until September 1 and restricts the number of people to 25 for funerals and 150 for weddings amid an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases and deaths. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210806-sri-lanka-tightens-covid-restrictions-as-hospitals-struggle (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 21,379 new cases of COVID-19, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 714,684. The country also reports a record 191 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 5,854. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2161103/record-191-new-covid-fatalities-21-379-new-cases (''Bangkok Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
****Seven fully [[COVID-19 vaccination in Belgium|vaccinated]] residents at a care home in [[Nossegem]], [[Flemish Brabant]], die after contracting the [[Colombia]]n [[Lineage B.1.621]] variant. [https://www.newsweek.com/seven-vaccinated-people-care-home-die-colombian-covid-variant-1616863 (Newsweek)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] imposes a [[curfew]] and a full ban on music in entertainment venues on the islands of [[Crete]] and [[Zakynthos]] in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. These measures will be in effect until August 13. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/greece-slaps-restrictions-two-tourist-islands-curb-covid-2021-08-05/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] begins to introduce the "''Green Pass''" where people over the age of 12  must present proof of [[COVID-19 vaccination in Italy|vaccination]] of at least one dose, a negative [[COVID-19 test|test]] from the previous 48 hours, or having recovered from COVID-19 in order to enter gyms, theatres and bars, dine in at restaurants, and participate in some leisure activities. [https://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/italy-covid-green-pass-needed-museums-indoor-dining-79310664 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****The [[White House COVID-19 Response Team]] announces that 50% of Americans have been fully vaccinated. [https://www.voanews.com/covid-19-pandemic/white-house-50-all-americans-are-fully-vaccinated (VOA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Arkansas]]
****An [[Arkansas]] judge temporarily blocks a law signed by [[Governor of Arkansas|Governor]] [[Asa Hutchinson]] that bans the state from imposing [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandates]]. [https://www.hotsr.com/news/2021/aug/07/judge-blocks-arkansas-from-enforcing-mask-mandate/ (''Hot Springs Sentinel-Record'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
****[[Florida]] reports a record 22,783 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.nbcmiami.com/news/local/florida-adds-single-day-record-22783-covid-19-cases-friday/2522980/ (WTVJ)]
***The number of COVID-19 cases in the U.S. reaches an average of 100,000 new cases per day for the first time since February. [https://www.usnews.com/news/top-news/articles/2021-08-05/us-covid-19-cases-hit-six-month-high-at-over-100-000-reuters-tally (US News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina]] surpasses five million cases of COVID-19 after reporting 13,549 new cases in the past 24 hours. [https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2021/08/06/argentina-supera-los-5-millones-de-contagios-de-covid-19/ (''Infobae'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru]] 
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Peru]]
*****[[President of Peru|Peruvian President]] [[Pedro Castillo]], [[First Lady of Peru|First Lady]] [[Lilia Paredes]], and [[Ministry of Health (Peru)|Health Minister]] [[Hernando Cevallos]] receive their first doses of the [[BBIBP-CorV|Sinopharm]] COVID-19 vaccine. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-08/07/c_1310113671.htm (Xinhuanet)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] states there will be no further laws on the Commonwealth or state levels requiring vaccines in certain workplaces and this will instead be left up to individual businesses to decide. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/aug/06/scott-morrison-says-mandating-vaccines-for-workers-will-be-left-up-to-businesses (''The Guardian'')]

'''International relations'''
*The [[Pacific Islands Forum]] opens with [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] addressing the summit, after being invited by [[Prime Minister of Fiji|Fijian Prime Minister]] [[Frank Bainimarama]]. Biden urges the [[Federated States of Micronesia]] to rejoin after the country withdrew over disagreements in the election of [[Henry Puna]] as the forum's [[Secretary General of the Pacific Islands Forum Secretariat|Secretary-General]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/448616/pacific-islands-forum-marks-50th-anniversary (RNZ)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the 2021 United States Capitol attack]]
**[[Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack]]
***[[New Jersey]] gym owner Scott K. Fairlamb and [[Washington (state)|Washington]] resident Devlyn D. Thompson pleads guilty to assaulting [[United States Capitol Police|U.S. Capitol Police]] officers during the [[2021 United States Capitol attack|January 6]] riot at the [[United States Capitol|Capitol]], becoming the first suspects to do so. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/legal-issues/first-guilty-pleas-police-assault/2021/08/06/c966ab9a-f6c3-11eb-9068-bf463c8c74de_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*A man [[mass stabbing|stabs passengers]] riding the [[Odakyū Odawara Line]] in [[Setagaya]], [[Tokyo]], Japan, injuring 10 people. The suspect, a man in his 30s, is arrested after turning himself in at a [[convenience store]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/08/06/asia/tokyo-train-stabbing-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Moldovan parliamentary election]]
**The [[Parliament of the Republic of Moldova|Moldovan parliament]] elects [[Natalia Gavrilița]] as the new [[Prime Minister of Moldova]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldovan-parliament-confirms-gavrilita-presidents-choice-new-pm-2021-08-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2020 Summer Olympics]]
**[[Canada at the 2020 Summer Olympics]], [[Football at the 2020 Summer Olympics]], [[LGBT athletes in the Olympic and Paralympic Games]]
***[[Canada|Canadian]] [[Association football|soccer player]] [[Quinn (soccer)|Quinn]] becomes the first [[Coming out|out]], [[transgender]], [[Non-binary gender|non-binary]] athlete to earn an [[Olympic medal]], after winning [[Gold medal|gold]] in the [[Football at the 2020 Summer Olympics – Women's tournament|women's tournament]] with the [[Canada women's national soccer team|Canadian national soccer team]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/nbc-out/nbc-out-proud/transgender-soccer-star-quinn-makes-history-olympic-gold-rcna1623 (NBC News)]
